scope: All 96 reported final tester-feedback native BMP captures for this path; excludes separate patch gate.
limitations: Observed hosted Windows captures at 96 DPI only. Main windows were 960×680 and 1024×728; editor/Samples 940×680, queue 940×590, review dialogs 720×530 and the import error 400×159. No high-DPI, multi-monitor, physical-trackpad or representative-PC acceptance is claimed.

Only saved frame representatives were visually inspected. Exact BMP SHA-256 duplicates reuse the named representative; most temporal samples are retained as RGB hashes and detector results, not separately saved images.

Finite sampled observations cannot exclude flashes between samples or before the first completed sample. Recorded completion-gap and first-sample timing summaries do not establish every rendered frame, zero flicker or input-to-paint latency.

Long list labels and paths may be elided or clipped within scrollable controls. Lower Methods/review/notice/detail text and some mapping/tree rows require scrolling. At 960×680 References lies partly below the general-settings viewport; fixed header/footer controls remain visible.

Save As and Add/Rename/Remove/Discard modal interactions are asserted by the native gate but have no individual screenshot in this capture set. This review does not claim their unseen layout coverage.

Synthetic overflow packs exist only in the disposable gate extraction. Synthetic sample science is a separate report assertion, not established by screenshot appearance or a biological/clinical validation claim.
The separate patch-gate immediate-resize transients remain recorded in their own visual evidence and are not superseded by these feedback captures.
summary: Editor grid, column/value controls and Save as/Use table/Cancel are readable and separated. Explicit synthetic-training notice and mapping guidance are visible within the notice viewport.

Planned Methods and missing-input Review and run are separately identifiable. Duplicate-ID import error is actionable. Preview displays one valid five-step sample; final queue visibly displays completed status.
Saved Run/category/overflow frames show no visible black corruption or fixed-control overlap. Long tree labels and some edge rows are cropped within their scrolling viewport.
evidenceMinimization: Focused receipt retains exact report/capture hashes and layout observations. Runtime window handles, local storage paths and redundant raw observations are omitted. Original BMPs remain in Actions artifacts.
